nobatch.name: 单条翻译

vlm.name: 纯文本识别
vlm.userPrompt: Extract all visible text from the image in its original language and reading order. Reconstruct logical paragraphs: merge visual line wraps within each prose paragraph, using spaces between words where required by the language. Do not preserve a newline just because text wraps in the image. Separate genuinely distinct paragraphs with a blank line. Preserve structural breaks in headings, lists, tables, code, and poetry. Do not translate, summarize, rewrite, or invent content. Return only the extracted text as plain text paragraphs, without adding Markdown formatting, explanations, or code fences.

vlm.name: 图片翻译
vlm.userPrompt: Translate all visible text into {{to}}. Return exactly {"format":"text","translation":{"text":"your complete translation","targetLanguage":"{{to}}","format":"text"}}. Omit original text and layout.

vlm.name: 双语解析
vlm.userPrompt: Extract all visible original text in reading order and translate it into {{to}}. Return exactly {"format":"text","text":"the complete original text","translation":{"text":"the complete translation","targetLanguage":"{{to}}","format":"text"}}. Omit layout.
